report.summary: The only failure, test_current_year_is_accepted, is a test bug: it creates a book with year THIS_YEAR + 1 (next year) and expects 201, but the app correctly rejects next year with 422. Fix the test to use THIS_YEAR, which is what its name describes, and leave the app alone. The seeded year_off_by_one bug is not active in this run.

causes.title: test_current_year_is_accepted submits next year and expects it to be accepted
causes.explanation: The test name and intent say the current year should be accepted, but the body passes year=THIS_YEAR + 1. The app's validation only allows years up to the current year (app/main.py:94 sets max_year to this_year unless the year_off_by_one seeded bug is enabled, and 95-96 reject anything above it with 422). So the 422 is the correct, spec-conforming response. The test is also inconsistent with the rest of the suite: test_invalid_book_is_rejected[next-year] (tests/api/test_books_api.py:58) asserts that THIS_YEAR + 1 is rejected, so the two tests contradict each other. The app's behavior is right; the test is wrong about which year it should send.
evidence: tests\api\test_books_api.py:50: assert response.status_code == 201 failed with 'assert 422 == 201', response <Response [422 Unprocessable Entity]>
tests/api/test_books_api.py:47-48: def test_current_year_is_accepted(api): response = api.create_book(title=unique("New"), author="Someone", year=THIS_YEAR + 1)

app/main.py:92-96: if book.year is not None: this_year = date.today().year; max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year; if not 1 <= book.year <= max_year: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
tests/api/test_books_api.py:58: ({"title": "T", "author": "A", "year": THIS_YEAR + 1}, "Year must be between"),  (expects rejection of next year)
app/main.py:9: year_off_by_one  accepts next year as a publication year (seeded bug, only active when BUGS env var includes it; no BUGS setting found in repo config)
causes.suggested_fix: Change the test to pass year=THIS_YEAR (so it really checks that the current year is accepted), keeping the 201 assertion. Optionally also assert the created year round-trips. Do not change app/main.py. Confirm the CI job does not set BUGS=year_off_by_one, since with that bug enabled the next-year rejection test would fail instead.
